investigation: Postboot Simulator setup responsiveness before app installation

primaryReferences.finding: The maintainer attributed a Simulator connection failure after selecting Xcode to CoreSimulator cache rebuilding and recommended initializing the simulator list before direct access for non-default Xcode versions.
primaryReferences.applicabilityLimit: That report involved platform-download connectivity on older image versions. It does not establish the cause of this run's postboot runtime-list timeout, and no cache deletion or workaround has been applied on its authority alone.

primaryReferences.finding: The reporter and maintainer documented PerfPowerServices consuming a CPU core. The maintainer later recorded that the image fix had completed rollout on December 15, 2025.
primaryReferences.applicabilityLimit: This is a candidate process to observe, not evidence of a current regression. No service preference change or process termination is justified without current measurements.

nextEvidence: A setup-only probe on the same Intel runner/Xcode/runtime, with bounded CPU, memory and process-name statistics before and after boot, plus a one-shot sample of the still-live owned command and a verified same-user CoreSimulatorService if the unchanged setup deadline is reached.
prohibitedInference: A pre-install infrastructure timeout is not an application reader failure, and moving a metadata check does not by itself prove the simulator is healthy.
